bookTitle: Adventures of Ethan and Leo: The Lost Map

scenes.title: The First Clue
scenes.alt: Ethan points from the old map toward a jagged island while Leo looks on excitedly from their rowboat at sunset.
scenes.caption: The first clue on the map guides Ethan and Leo toward the island's jagged peaks.

scenes.title: The Journal’s Warning
scenes.alt: Ethan reads their grandfather's worn journal as Leo watches anxiously beside the map in a boat surrounded by dark cliffs.
scenes.caption: Grandpa's journal warns the brothers that not every symbol leads to treasure.

scenes.title: The Spiral Symbol
scenes.alt: Ethan touches a glowing spiral on the map while Leo watches and a matching spiral constellation shines above their boat.
scenes.caption: A spiral on the parchment matches the pattern glowing among the stars.

scenes.title: Doubt and Resolve
scenes.alt: Leo rests a reassuring hand on Ethan's shoulder as Ethan holds the map and journal in their boat near the rocky island.
scenes.caption: Leo's confidence helps Ethan choose courage despite the warning ahead.

scenes.title: The Hidden Pattern
scenes.alt: Ethan traces a network of glowing golden points across the map while Leo leans closer and the island rises beyond their boat.
scenes.caption: Separate markings connect to reveal a hidden route across the map.

scenes.title: The Omen
scenes.alt: Leo rows hard through steep storm waves while Ethan protects the map and a lantern swings above their small boat.
scenes.caption: A sudden storm tests the brothers as the island looms through the waves.

scenes.title: The Revelation
scenes.alt: Ethan holds a glowing map whose bright trail points toward the island as Leo pauses at the oar beneath a brilliant dawn sky.
scenes.caption: The map finally reveals one clear trail leading straight to the mysterious island.

scenes.title: The Journey Ahead
scenes.alt: Ethan rows toward a towering green island while Leo holds the map open in their weathered boat under the morning sun.
scenes.caption: With their destination in sight, the brothers row toward the adventure waiting ashore.

scenes.title: Landfall
scenes.alt: Leo bounds joyfully across the island beach while Ethan walks carefully with the rolled map and their boat rests by the shore.
scenes.caption: Ethan and Leo take their first steps onto the island at sunrise.

scenes.title: The Shoreline
scenes.alt: Ethan kneels on a shell-strewn beach holding a spiral-marked stone shard while Leo examines it beside their boat and dark sea caves.
scenes.caption: A carved shard proves that the island itself is part of Grandpa's puzzle.

scenes.title: Into the Caves
scenes.alt: Ethan studies the map while Leo lights spiral and starburst carvings with a torch just inside a wet cave entrance.
scenes.caption: The brothers leave the bright shore and follow matching symbols into the caves.

scenes.title: The Echoes
scenes.alt: Ethan and Leo pause to listen in a wet tunnel where blue spiral reflections ripple across the carved walls and puddles.
scenes.caption: Mysterious echoes and glowing ripples seem to guide them farther underground.

scenes.title: The Hidden Chamber
scenes.alt: Ethan and Leo stand in awe before a vast ancient chamber filled with towering spiral-carved stones and warm torchlight.
scenes.caption: The narrow cave opens into a sanctuary hidden in the heart of the cliffs.

scenes.title: The Symbols Awaken
scenes.alt: Turquoise and gold symbols flare across the wall and map as Ethan reaches toward them and Leo raises the torch in amazement.
scenes.caption: The chamber awakens when its carvings align with the symbols on the map.

scenes.title: The Guardian’s Shadow
scenes.alt: Ethan and Leo stand together with their map and torch as a huge spiral-covered stone guardian forms from blue mist behind them.
scenes.caption: The island's ancient guardian rises from the chamber to face the brothers.

scenes.title: The Trial
scenes.alt: Ethan presses one hand to a bright turquoise spiral while Leo raises his torch and the guardian watches from the glowing chamber wall.
scenes.caption: Ethan and Leo meet the guardian's challenge with caution, courage, and trust.

scenes.title: The Choice
scenes.alt: Ethan holds the map while Leo reaches toward a glowing blue spiral path and a pale escape stairway rises on the opposite side.
scenes.caption: Together, the brothers choose the spiral path leading deeper into the island.
